ProdtSvcCmpnWorkType.name: ProdtSvcCmpnWorkType
ProdtSvcCmpnWorkType.description: Represents information about the eligible work types that can be associated with a product service campaign. Helps to identify and track the work types related to the impacted items, facilitating efficient execution of the product service campaign.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.description: The name of the product service campaign work type.

ProductServiceCampaignId.description: The product service campaign associated with the product service campaign work type.

WorkTypeId.description: The work type associated with the product service campaign work type.
